---
title: "Employee Attrition: Flight-Risk Model"
author: "Shadi Kadouri"
date: "2026-08-01"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
df <- read.csv("Employee.csv")
str(df)
```
```{r}
#data cleaning
library(tidyverse)
sum(is.na(df))
df <- df %>% 
  select(-any_of(c("EmployeeCount", "Over18", "StandardHours", "EmployeeNumber")))
df <- df %>% 
  mutate(Attrition_num = ifelse(Attrition == "Yes", 1, 0))
df <- df %>% 
  mutate(
    Attrition_num = ifelse(Attrition == "Yes", 1, 0),
    OverTime_num  = ifelse(OverTime == "Yes", 1, 0)
  )

df <- df %>% 
  mutate(AvgYearsPerCompany = TotalWorkingYears / (NumCompaniesWorked + 1)) %>% 
  group_by(JobRole) %>% 
  mutate(IncomeRatio = MonthlyIncome / mean(MonthlyIncome)) %>% 
  ungroup()
```
```{r}
#eda
library(tidyverse)

#attrition rate
df %>% 
  count(Attrition) %>% 
  mutate(Percentage = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 1))

#attrition x overtime
df %>% 
  group_by(OverTime, Attrition) %>% 
  summarise(Count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>% 
  group_by(OverTime) %>% 
  mutate(Percentage = round(Count / sum(Count) * 100, 1))

#graph 1: overtime vs attrition
ggplot(df, aes(x = OverTime, fill = Attrition)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(
    title = "Overtime vs attrition",
    x = "Overtime",
    y = "Share of employees"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

#graph 2: income ratio between who leave and who remain
ggplot(df, aes(x = Attrition, y = IncomeRatio, fill = Attrition)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(
    title = "Income ratio (vs role average) by attrition",
    x = "Attrition",
    y = "Income ratio"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
```{r}
library(tidyverse)

model <- glm(Attrition_num ~ Age + OverTime_num + IncomeRatio + AvgYearsPerCompany + JobSatisfaction + WorkLifeBalance + YearsSinceLastPromotion, 
  data = df, 
  family = binomial
)

summary(model)

# attrition probability
df <- df %>% 
  mutate(Risk_Probability = predict(model, type = "response"),
    Flight_Risk_Score = round(Risk_Probability * 100, 1),
    Risk_Level = case_when(
      Flight_Risk_Score >= 60 ~ "High",
      Flight_Risk_Score >= 30 ~ "Medium",
      TRUE                    ~ "Low"))

# how many employees in every risk level
df %>% 
  count(Risk_Level)


```
```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# risk levels distribution
ggplot(df, aes(x = Risk_Level, fill = Risk_Level)) +
  geom_bar() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Low" = "green", "Medium" = "orange", "High" = "red")) +
  labs(
    title = "Risk level distribution",
    x = "Risk level",
    y = "Number of employees"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# contingency table
table(Actual = df$Attrition, Predicted = df$Risk_Level)
```
